description: A committed terraform.tfstate. State files record every resource attribute in plaintext, including database passwords and generated secrets, which is why VC126 is critical. This fixture also covers a reachability fix: .tfstate was collected by no scan path — not the CLI, not the API, not this harness — so VC126 could never fire on a real project no matter how the rule was written. Adding the extension is the part that makes the rule do anything.
